title: “Comprehensive and efficient” MLA definitions; 3 confirmed to close in Flintshire
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: 521 libraries (460 buildings and 61 mobiles) currently under threat or recently closed/left council control out of 4517 in the UK 171 authorities listed out of 206 in UK, 133 of those are on record as (at least) considering closing libraries or making significant cuts (list below news), 56 on record as not closing libraries in 2011/2 (list at bottom) Known changes to library funding/opening since last posting –Flintshire – 3 libraries (Bagillt, Garden City and Gwernymynudd) confirmed to close, 2 (Queensferry and Halkyn) reprieved – therefore total goes down by 2
